acceptance_criteria: lease-expiry and unmapped-domain cases; CHK-13, NEG-14, NEG-23.
statement: An elapsed lease (a caller-supplied `now >= expires_at` in the lease's declared clock domain) **shall** become inactive and **shall** no longer authorize or conflict-block; the action path **shall** compare only values in one declared domain and **shall** never compare or order two raw mismatched clock domains (`XCOM-INV-09`) and **shall** perform no time-authority mutation.
title: T028 requirement 012
verification_intent: lease-expiry and unmapped-domain cases; CHK-13, NEG-14, NEG-23.
